projectSummary: Carried only as a qualifier: any statement about pectoralis major force derived from a static-optimisation model understates co-contraction, so modelled force values in this slice are treated as indirect.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: A methodological comparison, not a finding about the pectoralis major specifically.

study.intervention: Subject-specific neuromusculoskeletal modelling study validating static optimisation against measured activity.
study.population: A subject-specific neuromusculoskeletal model of the shoulder driven entirely by measured data was compared with static optimisation, and static optimisation was found to underestimate antagonist muscle activity at the glenohumeral joint.

title: Static optimization underestimates antagonist muscle activity at the glenohumeral joint: A musculoskeletal modeling study.
